title: Privacy policy creator (DE stub)
description: Structured privacy-policy stub from enums. Not legal advice. The language of the generated file comes from the Language param.
goalTemplate: Generate a privacy-policy *stub* (not legal advice) for EU/DE hosting, written in {{outputLanguage}}. Controller: {{controllerName}}. Country: {{country}}. Contact email: {{email}}. Hosting region: {{hostingRegion}}. Analytics/cookies: {{analytics}}. Output file: {{outputFile}}. Repos: {{repositories}}.\n\nWrite markdown sections: controller, hosting, cookies, data-subject rights, contact. Propose write to {{outputFile}} as dry-run diff. Never invent registration numbers, fines, or tax IDs.
